question:
**Select the denotation of the highlighted word.**

The black marketers are **hoarding **large quantities of groceries.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Piling Up**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hoarding **means the practice of collecting or accumulating something, such as money or food. (जमा करना)
 
• Marked option **Piling up** means to gather or be gathered in a pile; accumulate. (ढेर में इकट्ठा होना)
 
• Therefore, it is clear that the denotation of "**hoarding**" is "**piling up**"

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Doling Out** means to give or deliver in small portions. (छोटे हिस्से में देना)
 
• **Designing **means to create, fashion, execute, or construct according to plan. (योजना के अनुसार बनाना, फैशन करना, क्रियान्वित करना या निर्माण करना)
 
• **Training Up** means to study, practice, or exercise in order to prepare physically or mentally for some event, task, activity, etc. (किसी घटना, कार्य, गतिविधि आदि के लिए शारीरिक या मानसिक रूप से तैयार करने के लिए अध्ययन, अभ्यास या व्यायाम करना)
